name: no_yfinance_price_writers_lq1679_20261109
comment: ANCHOR: LQ-20261107-1679 — yfinance is never a price source (operator rule 2026-11-07: Finviz
fresh <=30 min, else a fresh Schwab/Alpaca/moomoo quote, else the stored mark flagged stale).
Measured on the live line 2026-11-09 before the fix: market_quotes 870 yfinance rows/3d (newest
15:56 ET), ticker_prices 881/7d (newest 2026-11-08 20:39), price_cache rebuilt from yfinance
weekly. This gate pins the three fixed store writers free of yfinance (AST), the Alpaca-only
backfill and cache read (behaviour with fakes), the retired --quotes-yf CLI (exit 2), and a
repo-wide SHRINK-ONLY ratchet: config/yfinance_import_baseline.json lists every remaining
importer with its kind, so a NEW import fails, a stale entry fails, and the price_read
follow-up set is frozen in the open rather than remembered. Synthetic symbols only; no DB, no
